iam@cloudshell:~/whosonset (my-film-jobs)$ ....

How do we fix this?

I need notifications to work, even if it means deleting them and creating new apporpriate ones

---

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

That error means `notifyFollowRequest` used to be an HTTPS function, and now it’s a Firestore trigger. Firebase won’t change the trigger type in-place — you must delete the old function first, then deploy.

Run this in Cloud Shell:

```sh
cd ~/whosonset

# Delete the old HTTPS versions (safe to re-create as Firestore triggers)
firebase functions:delete notifyFollowRequest --region us-central1
firebase functions:delete notifyNewMessage --region us-central1

# Then redeploy
firebase deploy --only functions
```

If you want to keep the HTTPS versions too, we can rename the new triggers instead.
